title: 50-dps verification of qou-09lg, qou-1fhe, qou-1lr8, qou-47sx, and qou-4fj6 (float64 argument binding, Markov ratio invariance, H_9 reachability, convention-D caller sweep, and H_3 Gram inverse float jump)

assertions.claim: dim_q((2,1), q) = q + 1/q satisfies dim_q(qMpf) - dim_q(qF64) = (qMpf - qF64)*(qMpf*qF64 - 1)/(qMpf*qF64) across the 8 consumer modules
Common weight scaling yScale cancels identically in tau_M(FULL)/tau_M(CONSTIT) while shifting individual traces by (yScale - 1)*tau, and y_lambda splits 47 + 223 = 270 (significant vs numerical zero)
Four H_9 extracts total 22750+22738+17559+17531 = 80578 raw float64 fields (drain 487597 - 127388 = 360209), n = 3*A separates A=2 (n=6) from H_9 (n=9), and cubic QR scaling holds
AST taint caller sweep partitions 2+2+1+15 = 20 live modules (12 producers owning 12+5 = 17 witnesses, disposed as 4+1+1+3+1+2 = 12), and two-run isolated delta cancels baseline drift
Enabling the 6x6 gram_inverse_H3 matrix plus 1 condition number increases raw float64 count by 6^2 + 1 = 37 (445 -> 482), and 2x2 Gram inverse satisfies a*(d/det) + b*(-b/det) = 1
